sources.title: SAeUron: Interpretable Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models with
sources.snippet: By training a separate SAE model for each diffusion timestep, they revealed the visual features learned by these models and their connection to class-specific information. In contrast to prior approaches, our work involves training a single SAE on activations from multiple denoising steps of a standard, non-distilled Stable Diffusion model.
